examples.text: Miro mi reflejo en el lago.
examples.en: I'm looking at my reflection in the lake.
I don't watch that program anymore.
I watch television with my daughter.

examples.text: Miro para comprar comestibles todas las mañanas.
examples.en: I shop for groceries every morning.

examples.text: Siempre que miro este cuadro pienso en mi padre.
examples.en: Every time I see this picture, I remember my father.
